text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even with the turn of the new year, 
attention on the "U.A.F." continues to 
soar. It is frequently featured on TV 
specials.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I heard from Sonnet Elfie about 
how she met Ryoka Tsurugi and the story 
behind the launch of the U.A.F. project.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to create a place where Umamusume 
who love sports can thrive even after 
retiring from racing— Ryoka Tsurugi agreed 
with her proposal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From then on, the two of them had run 
together to make this project—Sonon 
Elfie's "current dream"—a reality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by their powerful bond, they felt 
renewed determination to give it 
everything right to the very end alongside 
<chrname>.
